units.source_text: 听完阿民的这番话，阿住只能茫然的看着儿媳妇。

en.t: After listening to Amin say this, Azhu could only stare blankly at her daughter-in-law.

units.source_text: 她已经逐渐认清了一个事实。

en.t: She had already gradually come to recognize one fact.

units.source_text: 那就是不管她如何挣扎，不到她死的那天，她根本没办法过上轻松的日子。

en.t: It was that no matter how she struggled, she would never be able to live an easy life until the day she died.

units.source_text: 阿住重新又戴上了眼镜。

en.t: Azhu put her glasses back on again.

units.source_text: 接着，似是自言自语般为此次谈话做了一个总结。

en.t: Then, as if speaking to herself, she summed up the conversation.
